elements_selected.content: `zetl cap pair` SPAKE2-EE pubkey handoff per REQ-3408 (the CLI-commands REQ; distinct from REQ-3408 grants-file). Fresh CSPRNG-generated 4-word BIP39 phrase per pairing; refusal to reuse phrase within 30 days (tracked in `.zetl/caps/.pair-nonces`). Uses `@noble/curves` SPAKE2 for constant-time elliptic operations. Pairing completes with no server, no relay (messages exchanged via copy-paste / QR / in-person). Derived shared key used ONLY to authenticate pubkey handoff — not stored, not used for content encryption.
